aboutText: At Roundy Property Services, we take pride in keeping Mill Park properties looking their best. Based right here in Mill Park, we understand the local conditions and what it takes to maintain a healthy, vibrant lawn throughout the Victorian seasons. From regular mowing to full garden maintenance, our team delivers consistent, high-quality results for homeowners and businesses across Mill Park and Melbourne's northern suburbs.
servicesText: Roundy Property Services offers a comprehensive range of lawn and garden solutions for Mill Park residents and businesses. From weekly mowing to seasonal clean-ups, we tailor every service to suit your property's unique needs and keep your outdoor spaces looking their best year-round.
